status: Proposal awaiting user colors; not loaded by renderers yet

adm.meaning: Our ADM or action-selection scaling, consistently across RL, actor+ADM and API figures.

lookahead.meaning: Teacher evidence horizon, distinct from the ADM method identity.

oracle.meaning: Outcome-based oracle and outcome-label supervision; train/eval use related shades.

single_call.meaning: Single-call inference scaling; effort, tokens and browser-step budgets use shades/line styles.

failure.meaning: Failed rollout outcomes; keep hollow marks where already established.

attention.meaning: Allowed attention connections, confined to attention grids.

neutral_roles.MUTED: Secondary text, baseline references and frontier links
neutral_roles.BASELINE_LIGHT: First actor-only control and pre-execution labels
neutral_roles.BORDER: Axes, masks and thin box boundaries
neutral_roles.BACKGROUND: White canvas; soft fills derive from base colors rather than new hues
neutral_roles.PRE_EXEC: Pre-execution teacher labels; explicit semantic alias of an actor-baseline neutral
neutral_roles.ATTENTION_MASKED: Masked attention connections; derive from the neutral background/border
neutral_roles.FRONTIER: Pareto-frontier rings and dashed links; neutral structural role

non_color_encodings.teacher_vs_student: Hollow vs filled circles in teacher/student comparisons
non_color_encodings.actor_model_family: Marker shape in model comparisons; add a shape rather than a new color per model
non_color_encodings.configuration: Line style, fill and ordered tones within the same semantic family; define each figure legend explicitly

horizon_convention.definition: H counts the candidate action plus continuation actions

notes: Role variables remain distinct even when a chosen palette intentionally shares a family.
No colors have been changed by creating this proposal.
The H=1 role is retained for method/evidence illustrations; former post-execution result series are omitted from most plots, with the teacher/student horizon comparison explicitly restoring H=1.
The seven base colors are user choices; light/dark tones are derived, not independent choices.

category_cycle.purpose: External reference methods or diagnostic categories with no role above
category_cycle.rule: Use a figure-local ordered cycle drawn from the seven families, their tones and neutrals; no additional base-color choices required. Always label the categories explicitly.

proposal.status: For review only; existing figure palette remains unchanged
proposal.strategy: Palette 3 supplies ADM purples; palette 1 supplies semantic accents; palette 2 supplies neutral controls and text.
proposal.derived_colors: Darker salmon/green/yellow marks and light gray fills are derived from the supplied swatches; the source swatches are unchanged.
rules: Use saturated purple consistently for ADM across all result families.
Use salmon shades for teacher horizons, keeping the lookahead and ADM identities separate.
Use yellow and mint originals for fills; darker related tones for small markers, thin lines and colored text.
Teacher/student fill, actor-model shapes and cached shading remain independent of hue.
